newsitem.title: CHILE: Provida takes lead in Bolivian tender.
newsitem.headline: Provida takes lead in Bolivian tender.

text.p: Chilean pension fund administrator Provida said it won first place in a preliminary rating for two spots in Bolivia's private pension fund system.

Provida and its partner Franklin Templeton, a Franklin Resources Inc affiliate, scored 83 points in a numerical rating by Bolivian authorities, 10 points ahead of the next highest rating, which was for a consortium of Aetna Inc and J.P. Morgan & Co Inc, said Provida in a statement.
It gave no details on how the different bidders were scored, except that it was based on "fulfillment of the established requirements."
Provida, Chile's largest private pension fund operator, said it was one of 12 international bidders for the right to offer private pension services in Bolivia as of 1997.
